## Requirements: adopt Pierre Diffs for the read-only Git diff viewer

### Background / verified current baseline (2026-11-06)

Nession's Git capability already fetches bounded Git patches from the Agent: `crates/nession-git/src/runtime/diff.rs` executes `git diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv ... -- <path>`, and `git.diff/v1` returns `{ path, text, binary, truncated, truncated_bytes }`. `web/src/capabilities/git/components/GitDiffView.tsx` currently splits `diff.text` by newline and colors lines using prefix classification in a `<pre>`; there are no dedicated diff line numbers, side-by-side layout, or syntax-aware diff rendering.

**Decision:** adopt [`@pierre/diffs`](https://diffs.com/docs) as the **read-only rendering engine** for the existing local Git Workspace diff, first. Use the documented React patch input (`PatchDiff` from `@pierre/diffs/react`) against the existing bounded unified patch. Keep Nession as the owner of Git response states, path/session identity, layout chrome, style tokens, and lifecycle. This is not a new Git capability, nor a general AI Review or editor project.

Related: #750 (existing local read-only Git capability; completed), #1009 (commit history), #1290 (separate GitHub hosting context; **not** expanded here), #845 (separate Git mutations; explicitly excluded), #826 (Workspace disclosure). Pierre Trees / `react-arborist` selection and the Files editor are independent decisions.

### Scope / implementation boundaries

- Install one reviewed stable `@pierre/diffs` version and integrate its React entry within `web/src/capabilities/git/`; avoid importing Pierre implementation types into Rust contracts or `GitPlugin`. Respect Apache-2.0 license/NOTICE obligations and check bundle, runtime compatibility, and CSP/WebAssembly behavior. Prefer a JS highlighter fallback, not mandatory WASM.
- Keep `GitDiffView` as the Git-owned view and status/empty/error/header owner; add a small presentation adapter/component for bounded patch text and Pierre-specific options. Parse/memoize inputs by response identity; do not reparse on unrelated React renders or instantiate an unrelated global editor/Worker system.
- Render ordinary changed-file patches with syntax highlighting, line numbers and accurate add/delete/context semantics. Default to **unified/stacked**; permit a **split** switch when the available width makes it usable, with unified kept practical on the narrow App/phone presentation. Keep Nession tokens, typography, backgrounds and scroll clearance; do not transplant Pierre default design chrome or alter Workspace navigation.
- Preserve `GitWorkspace` current changes → file → diff workflow, history-selected-file diff, loading/error/unavailable states and Session-scoped stale-response guard. Preserve untracked-file non-openability and read-only Git semantics.
- Treat `binary`, empty/no-hunk or mode-only changes, malformed/unsupported Git patches, and `truncated=true` explicitly. A truncated patch is **not** complete even if a parser returns partial content; always show `truncated_bytes`, and use clearly labelled bounded raw-patch fallback on parse/render failure. Never silently discard patch lines or misrepresent an incomplete file as unchanged.
- Keep `git.diff` wire contract and Agent command/security/byte limits unchanged. Do **not** add `loadDiffFiles`/full-content hydration, expand unchanged context, in-place edits, accept/reject, staging, commits, synthetic untracked diffs, multi-file CodeView, PR review, or `@pierre/trees` migration in this slice. Those require separate data/authorization/product decisions.

### Primary paths

- `web/src/capabilities/git/components/GitDiffView.tsx`
- `web/src/capabilities/git/components/GitWorkspace.tsx` (only if required for display-mode state)
- `web/src/capabilities/git/components/__tests__/integration/`
- `e2e/tests/browser/fixture-git.spec.ts` (extend existing regression, no parallel browser suite)
- `web/package.json` and lockfile; existing Nession design-system theme/renderer boundary
- Reference-only contract: `web/src/generated/protocol/git/diff/v1.ts` (generated, **do not edit**)

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 Opening a modified file in the existing Git Changes view (and a commit-changed file in History when that view surfaces a diff) renders the correct bounded Git patch through Pierre Diffs, including file path, line numbers and accurate added/removed/context rows; where offered, switching unified ↔ split changes presentation without changing the underlying patch, selected file or Git request.
- [ ] SC-02 With binary, empty/mode-only, truncated and intentionally malformed patch fixtures, the view gives an accurate visible state: no invented hunks; truncation is disclosed with the real omitted-byte count; a rejected/failed patch renderer retains an explicit raw-patch fallback instead of a blank pane or a falsely complete diff.
- [ ] SC-03 At the canonical Web desktop and narrow App-like Chromium viewports, the selected diff remains usable and scrollable inside the existing Git Workspace, with legible text and no horizontal clipping of Workspace chrome or inaccessible view-mode control; new controls remain keyboard reachable and do not introduce Git write actions.
- [x] SC-04 Exact-source / focused test proof shows that `git.diff/v1` fields, Session-bound Git request routing, Agent byte cap and read-only boundary are unchanged, that the renderer consumes the generated response type, and that Pierre edit/hydration/write capabilities are not wired into this feature.

### Verification scenario mapping

- **SC-01–SC-03 → SCN-02 (Web/App browser interaction and visual):** existing `fixture-git` Playwright Chromium CI with deterministic changed-file, malformed/truncated/binary/no-hunk fixture variants and desktop + narrow viewport assertions. Record rendered line semantics (including Shadow DOM if present), toggle behavior, warning/fallback text, scrolling, accessibility and screenshots/traces at exact PR SHA. This extends an approved CI browser Case path; do not claim an unexecuted run Passed. Existing `fixture-git` tests currently assume `git-diff-body` contains `@@` and count exactly eight Git controls, so update those assertions to the new **explicit, read-only control contract**, not by weakening the write-control check.
- **SC-04 → SCN-01 (source/deterministic contract):** exact-source diff and focused existing TypeScript/integration/Gate results prove no Rust/protocol/security mutation and no editing/hydration path. Review exact PR SHA and targeted checks. No privileged credentials or remote service are necessary.
- **Timing:** all four predicates can be proven on isolated exact PR HEAD, so no staged/main/deployed/full-regression evidence is needed.

## Interactive prototype

- **Decision:** Not needed for this narrow slice: it replaces the renderer inside the already-approved Git Changes/History surface; no new navigation paradigm or multi-step interaction is being designed. The unified/split choice is a conventional local display option, not an editing workflow.
- **Uncertainty to resolve in implementation:** actual Pierre Shadow DOM theme mapping and 390px readability must be proved in the real browser; if this forces a material interaction/layout redesign, revisit prototype decision under `nession-prototype` before changing the product contract.
- **Status:** no separate prototype source or preview is claimed.

## Knowledge Impact

- Decision: None
- Related knowledge: Git capability / Web renderer topic (review existing knowledge if one is present); canonical source remains `#750`, current code and the Web design-system docs.
- Reason: a replaceable presentation dependency does not change the durable Git domain, auth, protocol or cross-surface architecture; avoid creating a duplicate knowledge article merely for a component swap.
- Owner and timing: Git/Web implementation reviewer to reassess when implementation changes a durable integration boundary.
- Evidence: this Issue, the implementation PR, official Pierre documentation and exact-SHA tests/Gates.

## Product alignment

- [x] Moves toward `VISION.md`: increases trust/readability of changes within an ongoing distributed Session without inventing another top-level tool.
- [x] Follows `PRINCIPLE.md`: existing context-driven Git view, progressive disclosure, Nession-owned visual grammar and quiet default.
- [x] Reviewed `docs/design/design-system/patterns/workspace-navigation.md` and existing Git capability (#750); Git content remains locally owned.
- [x] No intended deviation from the canonical product model.

### References

- Pierre docs: https://diffs.com/docs (React `PatchDiff`, patch input and highlighter selection)
- Git source: https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/web/src/capabilities/git/components/GitDiffView.tsx
- Existing Git browser regression: https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/main/e2e/tests/browser/fixture-git.spec.ts

**Status:** Approved — owner requested initial Diffs integration on 2026-11-06.
**Verification tier:** scoped (`verification:scoped`); no full-system regression requirement.
